1.d4 e5 2.Nf3 e4.strategy: Gains space and a tempo: the pawn hits the knight, which must move. Black takes more of the centre and cramps White's kingside development, accepting that the advanced pawn may become a target later.
1.d4 e5 2.Nf3 e4.name: Englund Gambit Declined: Reversed Krebs

1.d4 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ng1.strategy: Retreats to the starting square: the knight has lost two moves while Black's pawn has gained space on e4. White avoids complications but trails in development and space and lets Black play comfortably.
1.d4 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ng1.name: Englund Gambit Declined: Reversed Brooklyn

1.d4 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ne5.strategy: Jumps into the centre, but ...d6 kicks the knight away again, so Black gains time and space while White gets no lasting outpost. White's pieces end up tied to repairing the damage.
1.d4 e5 2.Nf3 e4 3.Ne5.name: Englund Gambit Declined: Reversed Mokele Mbembe
